thread:
emma (Customer): Hey team — our Europe entity got charged in USD but they require EUR invoices for local VAT reclaim. Invoice INV-2026-045 shows $12,345.67 and the customer's bank declined the capture because the PO number is missing. Can someone help? 🙏
sam (Support): thanks emma — can you share customer_id + the EU entity's tax id? Also which gateway was used (stripe/adyen)? tagging @olivia for billing
emma (Customer): customer_id: rc_73e2, EU tax id: DE123456789, gateway: stripe eu-west-1, payment_attempt_ts: 2026-03-15T14:22:10Z. The invoice PDF shows currency=USD. PO field is blank even though our order had PO: ACME-EU-PO-177
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2026-045 status: Paid (attempt), Payment method: card ****4242, Currency billed: USD, Customer currency preference: EUR, Tax region: DE — see /invoices/INV-2026-045
sam (Support): looks like two issues: 1) invoice currency mismatch (EUR vs billed USD) -> FX rounding and VAT mismatch 2) missing PO field causing customer-side card decline (bank requires PO on invoice). I'll escalate to billing. @olivia @raj
olivia (Billing): grabbing this. Quick check: was the order created under the parent account (USD) vs subsidiary (EUR)? We have a known edge where older orders default to account currency. Can you paste the order metadata JSON (redact PII).
emma (Customer): here's order metadata (redacted):
```
{ "order_id": "ord_9f2", "entity": "Acme GmbH (DE)", "billing_currency": "EUR", "po_number": "ACME-EU-PO-177", "created_via": "api", "partner_account": "global-acme" }
```
raj (Finance): metadata says billing_currency EUR and PO present, but invoices-bot shows USD billed. Maybe the invoice pipeline picked the parent entity mapping instead. Can we repro with the API call that created the order? Include payload + headers (esp X-Entity-ID / region).
emma (Customer): API payload our backend sent:
```
POST /v1/orders
{ "customer": "rc_73e2", "entity_id": "acme-de", "currency": "EUR", "po": "ACME-EU-PO-177" }
Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***, X-Region: eu-west-1
```
olivia (Billing): thanks. Repro steps I ran locally: 1) create order with entity_id=acme-de + currency=EUR -> order created 2) invoice generator pipeline (invoice-service v2.3.1) resolves entity by customer.parent_id when parent has default_currency USD -> bug: pipeline prefers parent.currency over explicit order.currency when parent has older billing_profile. Filing a bug.
olivia (Billing): root cause: fallback logic in invoice-service (src/billing/currency_resolver.py) uses parent currency if child mapping missing a 'primary' flag. For API orders that set currency explicitly we should respect that. I'll push hotfix to prevent EU charges in USD. Ticket BL-2489.
raj (Finance): for this invoice we need to: 1) void original USD invoice and issue credit note CN-2026-089 2) create new EUR invoice INV-2026-045-EUR with the PO and correct VAT breakdown 3) refund the card payment and post FX rounding adj. I'll calculate amounts.
sam (Support): confirmed card was charged then declined at the bank — refund required. Olivia can you confirm refund status? Need reissue ASAP, customer asked for docs before EOD CET.
olivia (Billing): refund initiated to card ****4242 for $12,345.67 — refund id rf_8842, status: pending (stripe). Created credit note CN-2026-089 voiding INV-2026-045. Generated INV-2026-045-EUR with net EUR 11,500.00, VAT 19% EUR 2,185.00, total EUR 13,685.00. Added ACME-EU-PO-177 to invoice. FX rounding diff posted as company loss EUR 4.32 -> GL-6001. Link: /invoices/INV-2026-045-EUR
emma (Customer): thank you!!! Can you confirm VAT number on new invoice matches DE123456789 and that it's marked 'Taxable domestic supply' so our reclaim works?
olivia (Billing): confirmed VAT DE123456789 is on the invoice and VAT classification set. Note: 'Issued per customer request for multi-entity currency correction. Original USD invoice voided CN-2026-089.'
raj (Finance): follow-ups:
- BL-2489: invoice-service fallback logic fix (olivia)
- OPS-7124: add automated check that invoice currency == order.currency for multi-entity accounts (sam)
- ACC-3302: posting FX rounding ledger entries and reconciliation (raj)
ETA: hotfix in prod 48hrs, full regression 2 weeks.
sam (Support): I'll reply to the customer with the new EUR invoice + credit note. emma, please confirm when refund posts to your bank, we'll keep thread open until cleared. :thumbsup:
emma (Customer): Refund pending in Stripe (rf_8842). I'll confirm once bank posts. Really appreciate the quick turnaround.
invoices-bot: Note: BL-2489 created by olivia; linked PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/billing/PR-532; OPS-7124 created by sam in task tracker.
